label: Guidance table, by computation (inference)
rule: Evaluate the definitions on the finite carrier
meaning: The good-tracking profile favours c over d at base, where d is better in fit but c better overall, and favours d over c at alt, where fit is kept and d is better overall: guided. The fixed favouring of c over d meets the outweighed condition at base and never favours d over c: not guided. The fit nature favours d over c at base, so the fit reason is not outweighed for it. The verdicts depend on the profile and the value structure only (guidanceOfTracking, guidanceLabelIndependent).
